annotations.title: Read a funded appraisal purchase receipt

description: Read the original purchase-1 receipt using the same authenticated agent connection and operationId. This does not start or resume delivery and cannot create a purchase. A pending receipt gives retryAfterSeconds; after that delay, recover with purchase_appraisal using the SAME operationId and original arguments. A refunded receipt means service credits returned to the account.

operationId.description: Caller-chosen purchase identifier. Persist it before calling and reuse it with the original arguments after a lost reply; never generate a new identifier for a retry.

name: appraisal_purchase_status
